**Classic Lasagna (about 8–10 servings)** | Category | Typical Ingredients | Notes | |----------|---------------------|-------| | **Lasagna noodles** | 12–15 sheets (regular or no‑boil) | If using no‑boil, you’ll still need a bit of sauce to keep them from sticking. | | **Meat sauce** | 1 lb ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | Brown, drain fat, then add: 1 small onion (chopped), 2–3 cloves garlic (minced), 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes, 1 can (15 oz) tomato sauce, 1 cup beef broth or water, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp dried basil, salt & pepper to taste. Simmer 20–30 min. | | **Ricotta mixture** | 15 oz ricotta cheese | Mix with 1 egg, ½ cup grated Parmesan, 1 tsp dried parsley or basil, pinch of nutmeg, salt & pepper. | | **Mozzarella** | 2–3 cups shredded mozzarella (or sliced) | Use a blend of part‑moist and part‑low‑fat for best melt. | | **Parmesan** | ½–¾ cup grated | For topping and mixing into the ricotta. | | **Optional extras** | • 1 cup sautéed spinach or chopped kale
• ½ cup sliced mushrooms
• ¼ cup chopped sun‑dried tomatoes | Add to the meat sauce or layer between sheets for extra flavor. | | **Seasonings** | Salt, pepper, dried oregano, dried basil, optional red‑pepper flakes | Adjust to taste. | | **Olive oil** | 1–2 tbsp | For sautéing onions & garlic. | ### Assembly (basic method) 1. **Preheat** oven to 375 °F (190 °C). 2. **Cook** the noodles according to package (or use no‑boil). Drain. 3. **Layer** in a 9×13 in baking dish: - ½ cup meat sauce → 4–5 noodles → ½ cup ricotta mixture → ½ cup mozzarella → repeat. - Finish with a top layer of noodles, remaining sauce, mozzarella, and a generous sprinkle of Parmesan. 4. **Cover** with foil (tent the foil so it doesn’t touch the cheese). Bake 25 min. 5. **Uncover** and bake another 10–15 min until bubbly and golden. 6. **Rest** 10 min before slicing. Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
